parsed.review_summary: The candidate edit correctly addresses all three error targets. It acknowledges that FedTrans is a unique aspect of the paper (fixing the evidence_misread), recognizes that the comment is fairly specific about the fairness issue (fixing the factual_error), and applies both the grounding and specificity dimensions of the rubric to identify the mid-level rubric match rather than the lowest level (fixing the rubric_misapplication/score_mapping_error). The rationale is coherent, preserves correct reasoning about the lack of section pinpointing, does not state a numeric score or gold label, and avoids leaking the omitted score values.
